items.heading: Ethical Hacking Is the Paid,
items.text: Ethical hacking is the paid, permitted version of what attackers do. A company, a startup or a platform asks you to break into its own systems, so that the weaknesses get fixed before a real attacker finds them.

items.heading: We Lead with the Routes
items.text: We lead with the routes that give you control over price and clients. The crowded or uneven ones stay on the list with their risk shown.

items.heading: This Is the Part Most
items.text: This is the part most hacking courses skip. In India the working rule is simple: no permission, no test.

rows: Your own pentest and audit boutique
You set the price per engagement, add clients through referrals, and later hire testers or package repeat work such as a yearly retest.
Not a starter route. Clients need to trust you with their systems, so it comes after a track record, a sample report and a few referrals.
Salaried pentester at a security firm, product company or large consultancy
Real client exposure and steady pay, but pay follows the firm's grade ladder. The layer is your own: a niche (web apps, Active Directory, mobile, cloud), a public reputation and later consulting.
Rarely open to freshers with no proof. Most listings expect hands-on evidence, and many expect prior IT or security experience.
Teaching what you can really do reaches many learners at once through batches, courses or corporate workshops.
Needs real field work first. Teaching with no practice behind it is the exact thing that feeds the course scams below.
A deep, small field. Very few roles, strong competition at the entry stage and a second, harder stage to reach senior research work.
Treat it as a later specialisation after years in pentesting, not as a first goal.

items.heading: Routine Web Scanning and First
items.text: Routine web scanning and first-pass checks for common bugs such as basic XSS and SQL injection, which automated tools now find at scale.

items.heading: Duplicate
items.text: Duplicate-prone bug bounty hunting on large, well-known programs where many people and tools look at the same targets.

items.heading: Template Reports That Restate
items.text: Template reports that restate a scanner's output without any judgment about business impact.
